physical_subject: What balance makes a Nim position difficult?
relationship: Normal-play Nim has losing positions exactly when the bitwise XOR of all pile sizes is zero.
operation: Stone piles map to binary rows; removing stones changes column parity.
closest_prior: Earlier chocolate strategy stealing and bridges parity
substantive_difference: Constructive binary invariant for normal-play Nim, not nonconstructive strategy stealing or Euler trails.
